# Roger McKenzie

> Software developer, photographer and content creator in Gainesville, Florida. Information Systems student at the University of Florida, with minors in Computer Science and Statistics.

The website is an interactive camera (a Sony ZV-E10) whose screen shows the site. The same content is in plain HTML inside index.html.

## About
- From Miami; first in his family to go to college.
- Software engineering intern at Amazon in Arlington, Virginia, in 2025 and 2026.
- Lead developer at The Agency at UF since April 2026.
- Off the clock: cooking, climbing, gaming, a home server, and tech videos on YouTube.

## Résumé
### Education
- University of Florida, B.S.B.A. in Information Systems, minors in Computer Science and Statistics. Graduating April 2028.
- Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, NVIDIA Fundamentals of Deep Learning.

### Software Development Engineer Intern, Amazon (Arlington, VA, May–Aug 2026)
- Designed the AWS infrastructure, security and data layers for a serverless ML recommendation service that replaced a manually tuned ranking heuristic, reducing manual evaluator outreach by 37%.
- Built the CDK infrastructure package and production CI/CD pipeline, including an encrypted DynamoDB feature store migrated from a legacy table with zero downtime.
- Architected a cross-account inference API (Fastify, TypeScript, Lambda) with SigV4 IAM authorization, Zod validation and per-client throttling; passed Amazon's Application Security Review and Operational Readiness Review.

### Software Development Engineer Intern, Amazon (Arlington, VA, May–Aug 2025)
- Built APEX, a full-stack A/B testing platform (React, TypeScript, tRPC, AWS Lambda, CloudFront, CDK) for email and SMS campaigns reaching over 1 million prospective candidates.
- Experiment creation with multi-arm forms, up to 100 treatment variations and live sample-size feedback at 80% power and 95% confidence.

### Lead Developer, The Agency at UF (Gainesville, FL, April 2026–present)
- Leads two internal platforms, Studio Stack and Research Resourcing, replacing spreadsheet coordination across three departments.
- Built Studio Stack's backend on Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS PostgreSQL and S3.
- Built a Slack-integrated AI resourcing agent (TypeScript, Lambda, DynamoDB, OpenAI API) that ranks researchers by availability and qualifications, cutting turnaround from hours to seconds.

### Skills
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, Java, SQL
- Cloud and tools: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, IAM, CloudWatch, CDK), Docker, Git, Vercel
- Frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js, Fastify, FastAPI, tRPC, Tailwind CSS, Zod

## Projects
- Studio Stack: production scheduling, brief intake and gear reservations for The Agency at UF. Cloud backend with role-based sign-in and workflow tracking (TypeScript, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, S3).
- [Jenna's Recipes](https://jennarecipes.vercel.app): recipe search by ingredient, Gemini suggestions and a saved shopping list (React, TypeScript, MUI).
